info.name: SriSu - Couple Moments API tests
info.description: 89 executable request cases. Read the accompanying guide. Set four access tokens and base_url; run folders 01-04, configure files and run 05, then run 06. Folder 07 is manual/conditional. Never run every folder blindly. No credentials are included. Cases 78-89 in folder 04 test partner replies, embedded private notes and unique view counts.

item.name: 01 - Create fixtures
item.description: Run these first. Creator and partner must be active members of the same accepted couple. IDs are saved automatically.

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Postman cafe test",
  "caption": "Coffee and a rainy afternoon",
  "moment_date": "2026-09-14",
  "mood": "happy",
  "location_name": "Kathmandu",
  "visibility": "public",
  "tags": [
    "coffee",
    "travel"
  ],
  "partner_memory": "A lovely afternoon"
}

exec: pm.test("Exactly 24 hours", () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(Date.parse(d.expires_at) - Date.parse(d.created_at)).to.eql(86400000); });

item.name: 04 Other partner also creates a moment

exec: pm.test("Creator permissions", () => { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.can_edit).to.eql(true); pm.expect(d.can_delete).to.eql(true); });
pm.test("Partner cannot modify", () => { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.can_edit).to.eql(false); pm.expect(d.can_delete).to.eql(false); });

item.name: 12 Ownership and expiry spoofing are ignored

exec: pm.test("Ownership and expiry remain server-controlled", () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(String(d.created_by)).to.eql(String(pm.collectionVariables.get("creator_user_id"))); pm.expect(d.expires_at).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("original_expiry")); });

item.name: 84 Couple member receives embedded appreciation threads

request.description: Run after case 44 and before deletion. Expected 200; authenticate as partner.

exec: pm.test("Notes and replies embedded for partner", () => { const d = pm.response.json(); const n = d.appreciation_notes.find(n => String(n.id) === String(pm.collectionVariables.get("note_id"))); pm.expect(n).to.be.an("object"); pm.expect(n.replies.length).to.eql(2); });

item.name: 85 Outside viewer receives count without private threads

request.description: Run after case 44 and before deletion. Expected 200; authenticate as sender.

exec: pm.test("No embedded notes for outsiders", () => { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d).not.to.have.property("appreciation_notes"); pm.expect(d.total_view_count).to.be.a("number"); pm.collectionVariables.set("view_count_baseline", d.total_view_count); });

item.name: 86 Repeated detail GET does not inflate view count

request.description: Run after case 44 and before deletion. Expected 200; authenticate as sender.

item.name: 87 Feed includes count without recording another view

request.description: Run after case 44 and before deletion. Expected 200; authenticate as sender.

exec: pm.test("Feed count agrees", () => { const m = pm.response.json().data.results.find(m => String(m.id) === String(pm.collectionVariables.get("public_moment_id"))); pm.expect(m.total_view_count).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("view_count_baseline"))); pm.expect(m).not.to.have.property("appreciation_notes"); });

item.name: 06 - Permanent deletion - run last
item.description: These requests delete only moments/notes whose IDs were captured by this collection. Run conditional expiry/membership tests before this folder if desired.

item.name: 63 Create note to verify cascade deletion
66 Notes are deleted with their moment
07 - Conditional expiry tests - manual only
item.description: Do not include this folder in an ordinary collection run. Requires expired_moment_id, expired_photo_id and retained_note_id prepared as described in the guide. Use an expired PUBLIC moment authored by creator, with a note authored by sender; expiry must be less than 30 days ago.

item.name: 73 Expired moment cannot be deleted via ordinary API
75 Sender retains access to earlier note
76 Original partner retains access to earlier note
77 Expired moment excluded from couple feed

exec: pm.test("Expired ID absent", () => { const id = String(pm.variables.get("expired_moment_id")); pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.results.some(m => String(m.id) === id)).to.eql(false); });
